rs.key_step: 将solve→confirmativeverify→纠错迭代构造成SFT行为，再比较终局RLOO与按rewardhistory分组的processRL。
rs.why_non_obvious: 错误trial来自本模型而非只模仿强teacher长CoT，SFT mask不直接学失败solution。
rs.trigger_condition: When weaker models lack self-correction behavior, initialize explicit verify-and-revise trajectories before outcome or process RL.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When weaker models lack self-correction behavior, initialize explicit verify-and-revise trajectories before outcome or process RL.

signatures.information: 自身失败解、GT校验、confirmation verdict、correct finaltrial
signatures.failure_boundary: 仅7/8B；确认正确性与数学完整证明不同；错误rewardhistory相同不保证真实state等价。

relevance.how: 直接展示先初始化纠偏行为再RL。
SFT失败trial留上下文但mask其solution，适合纠偏轨迹构造。
